CustomField.formula:
IF( State_Assessment_Fee_Surcharge_Included__c = TRUE, "Included", IF( State_Assessment_Fee_Surcharge_Included__c = FALSE && NOT(ISBLANK(State_Assessment_Fee_and_Surcharge__c)) , TEXT( (State_Assessment_Fee_and_Surcharge__c * 100))&"%", null
))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays "Included" if the State Assessment Fee/Surcharge Included field is checked. If the field is not checked and theres a surcharge fee, the fee is displayed on the proposal.
CustomField.label: Proposal State Assessment and Surcharge
